If the `embed_category` site setting row doesn’t exist or the join returns zero rows, `execute(...)[0]` will be `nil` and `['id']` will raise, so the later fallback `if category_id == 0` is never reached. Also, even if that first query were guarded, the fallback `execute("SELECT value FROM site_settings WHERE name = 'uncategorized_category_id'")[0]['value']` has the same unchecked `[0]` access and would raise if that row is missing at that migration point.
